_comment: source: 'mock' | 'serial'. serial reads the bench Arduino Mega (rig-monitor sketch, COM11 @ 115200) into bay 1; netConfigPath feeds units from the Pi TCP rigs (net wins over serial for the same unit). belt_speed scale is a placeholder (raw Hz) until the encoder PPR is known. automation.repo points at the TabletAutoTest checkout so real bays can launch its workflows from Test Control. FP2 consoles (TabletAutoTest FP2 gateway, :8102): a bay binds to the console for the model placed on it — NTL17915 -> pm210, NTL17624 -> if20, PFTL59724 -> if17-xylophone, PFTL90924 -> if17-esp (server/src/consoles.ts), each with its Renode LCD proxied. Overrides, first hit wins: bay.console from the floor editor (BLE by device code, or 'emulator' = the placed model's emulator), then fleet.consoles per bay: "u03": "dfab" (BLE desk console, no LCD) or {"link": "pm210", "lcd": "http://10.0.0.5:8889"}. fleet.models seeds the floor only when lab.json does not exist yet (POST /api/lab/reset reseeds; the lab editor changes models live and rebinds the console). Restart the server after editing this file (tsx watch ignores it).
